title: Pro-government Amhara peace/law-enforcement rallies on 18 December
reason: Reports describe rallies supporting peace, government initiatives/law enforcement and calls on armed actors to disarm or pursue peace. Those reported messages are not an anti-state demand. Separately reported anti-government chants/protests remain candidate ETH24DEC-E001 and are not merged with this excluded activity.
notes: The rally organizers, coercion allegations, exact sites, crowd sizes and source dependencies remain disputed or unknown; exclusion is limited to the described pro-government component.
